description:
When you stare into the Abyss, the Abyss stares back at you.

---

A First Person Horror game where you have to restart the old generator and DO NOT MEET THE ENTITY.

/!\ The build is very likely to be broken (the player teleports), 
if the problem occurs, test it on unity editor mode by downloading
the project on GitHub.

---

CONTROL

ZQSD - Movement

Shift/Alt - Sprint

Right Click - On/Off Light
